about: Documented stage clears and failures at the 35% and 15% brackets (and one post-easing clear re-bracketed to 55%), highest stage first within each era. team_power is as posted; recommended_power is the current (post-2026-09-23) game value and is given only for clears made after the easing, since the easing lowered 169-1 to 328-30. evidence: 'screenshot' when the post shows the result or formation, 'text' when only stated. standing: whether this record accepts the attempt as shown, from README.md. 'accepted' for every screenshot (Reasoning 4 counts the screenshot clears, and the 256-30 and 289-4 failures, as the measurements) and for the one text clear the README rests on (216-30, where Reasoning 4 starts the pre-easing 35% line); 'rejected' for the 328-30-at-15% claim, which the Verdict and the steelman's answer reject ('the claims have no screenshots, and the measured attempts don't support them'); 'unverified' for the other text-only claims, which the README neither rests on nor rejects. deck names a curated deck when the lineup matches one. boss_en gives the boss's English as README.md's clears table names it, on rows whose boss the stage tables (stage-chapters.json, stage-zones.json) don't name.
